reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    Jurisdiction: Georgia
    Focus year: 2021
    Question: Does state/territory eviction law explicitly regulate corporate landlords?

    The program encodes the provided statutes (GA Code  44-7-59 and  44-7-50, 2021)
    and then answers whether those eviction statutes explicitly regulate "corporate landlords".
*/

% -------------------------------
% Scenario (question) facts
% -------------------------------

scenario_state(georgia).
scenario_focus_year(2021).

% The user question, represented as a scenario goal we can reuse.
scenario_statement :-
    scenario_state(georgia),
    scenario_focus_year(2021).

% -------------------------------
% Statute inventory (as provided)
% -------------------------------

% The dataset of eviction-related statutes we are considering for the scenario.
statute_in_force(georgia, 2021, ga_code_44_7_59).
statute_in_force(georgia, 2021, ga_code_44_7_50).

% ---------------------------------------------------------
% Statute encoding: GA Code  44-7-59 (2021)
% ---------------------------------------------------------
% Citation: GA Code  44-7-59 (2021)
%
% Core meaning encoded:
% If (1) court issues writ of possession to property upon which tenant placed transportable housing,
% and (2) tenant does not move it within 10 days after a final order is entered,
% then landlord is entitled to have the transportable housing moved at tenant's expense by a
% licensed motor common carrier. A lien exists for moving fees and storage expenses; storage fees
% expressly allowed up to $4/day. Lien claimed/foreclosed like special liens on personalty by mechanics
% under Code Sections 44-14-363 and 44-14-550 (we do not encode those external procedures here).

% Helper: what counts as "transportable housing" per the statute's examples.
ga_44_7_59_transportable_housing_type(manufactured_home).
ga_44_7_59_transportable_housing_type(mobile_home).
ga_44_7_59_transportable_housing_type(trailer).
ga_44_7_59_transportable_housing_type(other_transportable_housing).

% Threshold: tenant must move within 10 days; otherwise consequences.
ga_44_7_59_deadline_days(10).

% Cap: storage fees not to exceed $4.00 per day.
ga_44_7_59_storage_fee_cap_per_day(4.00).

% Deterministic entitlement rule:
% ga_44_7_59_landlord_entitled_to_move(+DaysAfterFinalOrder, -Entitled)
% Entitled = yes/no based on >10 days.
ga_44_7_59_landlord_entitled_to_move(DaysAfterFinalOrder, yes) :-
    ga_44_7_59_deadline_days(Deadline),
    number(DaysAfterFinalOrder),
    DaysAfterFinalOrder > Deadline,
    !.
ga_44_7_59_landlord_entitled_to_move(_DaysAfterFinalOrder, no) :-
    !.

% Deterministic cap check for storage fee:
% ga_44_7_59_storage_fee_allowed(+FeePerDay, -Allowed)
% Allowed = yes/no.
ga_44_7_59_storage_fee_allowed(FeePerDay, yes) :-
    ga_44_7_59_storage_fee_cap_per_day(Cap),
    number(FeePerDay),
    FeePerDay =< Cap,
    !.
ga_44_7_59_storage_fee_allowed(_FeePerDay, no) :-
    !.

% ---------------------------------------------------------
% Statute encoding: GA Code  44-7-50 (2021)
% ---------------------------------------------------------
% Citation: GA Code  44-7-50 (2021)
%
% Core meaning encoded:
% When tenant holds over beyond term OR fails to pay rent when due OR is tenant at will/sufferance,
% and owner desires possession, owner (or agent/attorney in fact/attorney at law) may demand possession.
% If tenant refuses/fails to deliver possession, owner or agent/attorney may go before enumerated officers
% and make an affidavit under oath to the facts; affidavit may likewise be made before a notary public.
% If issued by a public housing authority, the demand may be provided concurrently with federally required
% notice of lease termination in a separate writing.

% Enumerated "reasons" that trigger the owner's right to demand possession.
ga_44_7_50_reason(holds_over_beyond_term).
ga_44_7_50_reason(fails_to_pay_rent_when_due).
ga_44_7_50_reason(tenant_at_will).
ga_44_7_50_reason(tenant_at_sufferance).

% Enumerated categories who may demand possession on behalf of owner.
ga_44_7_50_demand_made_by(owner_individually).
ga_44_7_50_demand_made_by(agent).
ga_44_7_50_demand_made_by(attorney_in_fact).
ga_44_7_50_demand_made_by(attorney_at_law).

% Enumerated officials before whom the affidavit can be made (as described).
ga_44_7_50_affidavit_officer(superior_court_judge).
ga_44_7_50_affidavit_officer(state_court_judge).
ga_44_7_50_affidavit_officer(clerk_of_superior_or_state_court).
ga_44_7_50_affidavit_officer(deputy_clerk_of_superior_or_state_court).
ga_44_7_50_affidavit_officer(judge_of_other_court_with_jurisdiction).
ga_44_7_50_affidavit_officer(clerk_of_other_court_with_jurisdiction).
ga_44_7_50_affidavit_officer(deputy_clerk_of_other_court_with_jurisdiction).
ga_44_7_50_affidavit_officer(magistrate_in_district_where_land_lies).
ga_44_7_50_affidavit_officer(notary_public).

% Deterministic: may demand possession if reason is one of the statute reasons and owner desires possession.
ga_44_7_50_may_demand_possession(Reason, OwnerDesiresPossession, yes) :-
    ga_44_7_50_reason(Reason),
    OwnerDesiresPossession == yes,
    !.
ga_44_7_50_may_demand_possession(_Reason, _OwnerDesiresPossession, no) :-
    !.

% Deterministic: if tenant refuses/fails after demand, owner/authorized representative may make affidavit
% before an authorized officer.
ga_44_7_50_may_make_affidavit(RefusedOrFailedToDeliverPossession, MadeBy, Officer, yes) :-
    RefusedOrFailedToDeliverPossession == yes,
    ga_44_7_50_demand_made_by(MadeBy),
    ga_44_7_50_affidavit_officer(Officer),
    !.
ga_44_7_50_may_make_affidavit(_RefusedOrFailedToDeliverPossession, _MadeBy, _Officer, no) :-
    !.

% Deterministic: public housing authority special rule about concurrent demand with federal termination notice.
ga_44_7_50_public_housing_authority_concurrent_demand(IssuerIsPublicHousingAuthority, yes) :-
    IssuerIsPublicHousingAuthority == yes,
    !.
ga_44_7_50_public_housing_authority_concurrent_demand(_IssuerIsPublicHousingAuthority, no) :-
    !.

% ---------------------------------------------
% "Explicit regulation of corporate landlords"
% ---------------------------------------------
% We operationalize "explicitly regulate corporate landlords" as:
% A statute explicitly references corporate status for landlords/owners (e.g., "corporation",
% "corporate", "LLC", "incorporated", "company as landlord") OR creates a rule that applies
% specifically because the landlord/owner is a corporate entity.
%
% The provided statute texts, as encoded here, do not include such corporate-specific actor terms.

% Actor-terms explicitly referenced by each provided statute (from the text).
% This is used to detect whether corporate landlords are explicitly mentioned.
statute_actor_term(ga_code_44_7_59, landlord).
statute_actor_term(ga_code_44_7_59, tenant).
statute_actor_term(ga_code_44_7_59, motor_common_carrier).
statute_actor_term(ga_code_44_7_59, department_of_public_safety).
statute_actor_term(ga_code_44_7_59, person_performing_services).
statute_actor_term(ga_code_44_7_59, mechanic_special_lien_reference).

statute_actor_term(ga_code_44_7_50, tenant).
statute_actor_term(ga_code_44_7_50, owner).
statute_actor_term(ga_code_44_7_50, agent).
statute_actor_term(ga_code_44_7_50, attorney_in_fact).
statute_actor_term(ga_code_44_7_50, attorney_at_law).
statute_actor_term(ga_code_44_7_50, superior_court_judge).
statute_actor_term(ga_code_44_7_50, state_court_judge).
statute_actor_term(ga_code_44_7_50, clerk).
statute_actor_term(ga_code_44_7_50, deputy_clerk).
statute_actor_term(ga_code_44_7_50, magistrate).
statute_actor_term(ga_code_44_7_50, notary_public).
statute_actor_term(ga_code_44_7_50, public_housing_authority).

% Terms that would count as an explicit "corporate landlord" reference.
corporate_specific_term(corporation).
corporate_specific_term(corporate_landlord).
corporate_specific_term(incorporated).
corporate_specific_term(llc).
corporate_specific_term(limited_liability_company).
corporate_specific_term(company_landlord).
corporate_specific_term(corporate_owner).

% True when the statute explicitly mentions a corporate-specific term.
statute_explicitly_mentions_corporate_landlord(StatuteId) :-
    statute_actor_term(StatuteId, Term),
    corporate_specific_term(Term),
    !.

% True when the state/year eviction statutes (provided here) explicitly regulate corporate landlords.
explicit_corporate_landlord_regulation(State, Year) :-
    statute_in_force(State, Year, StatuteId),
    statute_explicitly_mentions_corporate_landlord(StatuteId),
    !.

% -------------------------------
% Final answer
% -------------------------------

housing_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_statement,
    scenario_state(State),
    scenario_focus_year(Year),
    explicit_corporate_landlord_regulation(State, Year),
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    scenario_statement,
    !.

% -------------------------------
% Main / initialization
% -------------------------------

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Does state/territory eviction law explicitly regulate corporate landlords?
